description:
This scene is such a powerful reminder to stop worrying so much about things that you can't control.

Life is short. Time moves fast. And none of us know how long we really have.

So, tell people how much they mean to you. 
Make great memories. 
Do the thing you keep putting off.

Because in the end, the life you create is the legacy you leave behind.

Make it one you’re proud of.

📌 Save this as a reminder. 
🔁 Share it with a friend.

📹 Media Credit: Jack (1996) / Robin Williams
transcript: Hey, look at me. Please, don't worry so much. Because in the end, none of us have very long on this earth. Life is fleeting. And if you're ever distressed. Cast your eyes to the summer sky. When the stars are strung across the velvety night. And when a shooting star streaks through the blackness turning night into day. Make a wish. Think of me Make your life Spectacular I know I did
